jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - part-time or weekend work
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card
• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

Our client is an international logistics leader and is looking for an Air Export Administrative Agent to strengthen their Air Export Team in the Machelen region. 

We offer an initial fixed-term contract of 1 month, starting on 1 September, allowing sufficient time for onboarding and knowledge transfer followed by a replacement contract covering a maternity leave and subsequent absence.

The total expected assignment duration is approximately 12 months.

Your Role:

As an Air Export Administrative Agent, you will be responsible for the accurate and timely processing of air export shipments while ensuring excellent customer service throughout the shipment lifecycle. You will work closely with customers, airlines, and internal departments to guarantee smooth and efficient operations. 

Key Responsibilities:

Air Freight Administration
	
• Track and trace air export shipments through online systems and email communication.	
• Manage and process shipment-related documentation accurately. 	
• Upload shipment documents into electronic document management systems.	
• Support the handling of shipment pre-alerts and storage requirements, including temperature-sensitive shipments. 	
• Follow up on active container leasing and end-of-lease activities. 
Customer Service
	
• Inform customers proactively about shipment status updates and delays.	
• Respond professionally to customer inquiries.	
• Ensure customer requirements and operating procedures are consistently respected. 
Compliance & Operational Excellence
	
• Escalate operational issues to management when necessary.	
• Support continuous improvement initiatives to increase operational efficiency and service quality.	
• Ensure compliance with company procedures, customer requirements, and regulatory guidelines.	
• Follow up on operational discrepancies and system-related issues.	
• Assist with claim notifications to airlines when required. 

Your Profile:

We are looking for a motivated logistics professional who thrives in a dynamic international environment.

Requirements
	
• Knowledge of the air freight process and transport documentation.	
• A background in Transport & Logistics or a similar education is highly valued.	
• Administrative experience or strong administrative skills.	
• Comfortable managing multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.	
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 
Proactive and able to work independently. 

Good computer skills and ability to quickly learn new systems.
	
• Fluent in Dutch and English (spoken and written).	
• Strong communication skills with both customers and colleagues.
Personal Qualities
	
• Customer-focused and service-minded.	
• Flexible and willing to go the extra mile when operational needs require it.	
• No strict "9-to-5" mentality.	
• Professional attitude and willingness to follow company procedures, policies, and dress code.	
• Strong team player with a positive mindset.

Main Responsibilities

The Technical Sales Manager contributes annually to the development of a strategic sales plan, in consultation with management (including objectives, KPIs, segmentation, and action points). In addition, weekly consultations and monthly reporting will be required.

Building and expanding a proactive and sustainable network of customers, prospects, partners (suppliers, machine builders, ...)

In most projects, the Technical Sales Manager will act as coordinator between customers, engineering offices, partners, suppliers, and the Revimaxx team.

You continuously monitor the market and trends and also share these internally. You pay attention to developments in technologies, relationships between customers/partners, subcontracting, opportunities, ...

You are open to and contribute to active marketing support, social media communication, participation in trade fairs, training sessions, ...

In this role, a combination of technical/mechanical expertise and a sense for economic reality is necessary. This may have been built through experience, interest, education... or perhaps through a combination of these.

• Industrial Engineer, Civil Engineer, or equivalent through experience

• You have a strong affinity with the machine construction sector and are passionate about the mechanical possibilities of small and large machines/systems.
• Your commercial experience motivates you to independently evaluate opportunities and pursue them.
• You are conceptually strong and enjoy thinking together with the customer in a co-creative way to arrive at the best solution for their challenge.

• You possess strong communication skills and communicate effectively with customers, partners, and the Revimaxx team. (knowledge of perfect English, and willingness to learn Dutch quickly)
• You have a natural ambition to grow and to support the growth of Revimaxx.
• You are results-oriented, loyal, flexible, and demonstrate strong perseverance.
• You hold a valid for wheel driving licence.

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools.

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers

Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!
